simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צֶלַע (H6761) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: צֶלַע (tselaʻ) means a limping or full (figuratively) First listed occurrence: Jer 20 10.

definitions.full: H6761. tsela צֶ֫לַע noun [masculine] limping, stumbling ; — figurative of calamity, absolute ׳לְצ Psa 38:18 I am ready ( נָכוֺן ) for stumbling (and falling); suffix בְּצַלְעִי 35:15 at my stumbliing ; צ ׳שֹׁמְרֵי Jer 20:10 watchers of my stumbling ; לְצַלְעוֺ נָכוֺן אֵיד Job 18:12 ruin is ready for his stumbling. - See also צֵלָע construct
